words.grammar: consist of + 部分，不用被动

words.note_zh: 比 consist of 正式，不用被动。

patterns.note_zh: be made up of + 部分。

patterns.frame: The bar for {period} breaks down into several segments, of which the largest accounts for {share}.
patterns.zh_frame: {period}的柱子分为几部分，最大一块占 {share}。
patterns.note_zh: of which 引导非限定从句。

traps.wrong_en: The bar is consisted of three parts.
traps.right_en: The bar consists of three parts.

registers.general: {category} splits into several parts; the biggest is {share}.
registers.ielts: The bar for {period} is divided into segments, with the largest accounting for {share}.
registers.business: {category} breaks down into several blocks; the largest is {share}.

words.grammar: the biggest chunk of + 整体

words.note_zh: 口语，可指时间空间比例。

words.grammar: the largest component of + 整体

patterns.frame: {series_name} takes up the biggest part in {period} — about {share}.
patterns.note_zh: take up 比 occupy 自然。

patterns.frame: {series_name} is the largest component in {period}, at {share} of the total.
patterns.zh_frame: {series_name}是 {period} 的最大组成部分，占总量 {share}。
patterns.note_zh: at + 比例 + of + 整体。

traps.wrong_en: The most part of the bar is food.
traps.right_en: The largest part of the bar is food.
traps.why_zh: 比例大用 large，不用 most。

registers.general: {series_name} is the biggest part in {period}, at about {share}.
registers.ielts: {series_name} was the largest component in {period}, accounting for {share}.
registers.business: {series_name} is the dominant block in {period}, at {share}.

words.note_zh: 口语也说 twice as big。

words.grammar: grow by（增量）/ grow to（结果）

words.note_zh: 强调规模范围，不直接接百分比增量。

patterns.frame: {series_name} grew in {period}, to {share} of the total.
The {series_name} segment expanded to {share} in {period}, while the rest held steady.

traps.wrong_en: Delivery grew 5 percent, from 20 to 25 percent.
traps.right_en: Delivery grew by 5 percentage points, from 20 to 25 percent.
traps.why_zh: 20% 到 25% 是 5 个百分点，不是 5%。

registers.general: {series_name} kept growing in {period}, reaching {share} of the total.
registers.ielts: The {series_name} segment expanded to {share} in {period}, while other components changed little.
registers.business: {series_name} grew to {share} in {period}, taking share from the rest of the mix.

patterns.frame: {series_name} took a bigger share in {period}, at {share}.
The period saw a shift toward {series_name}, which rose to {share} in {period}.
patterns.zh_frame: 这一时期出现向{series_name}的转移，{period}升到 {share}。
patterns.note_zh: the period saw + 名词 是书面结构。

registers.general: {series_name} took a bigger slice in {period}, at {share}.
registers.ielts: There was a marked shift toward {series_name}, whose share rose to {share} in {period}.
registers.business: {series_name} is eating into the rest of the mix, reaching {share} in {period}.

words.note_zh: 比 steady 更正式，强调能维持。

patterns.frame: Across {period}, {series_name} kept taking a bigger share.
The dominant trend is the steady expansion of {series_name}, which now accounts for {share}.
patterns.zh_frame: 主导趋势是{series_name}持续扩大，现已占 {share}。

traps.why_zh: 说清是哪个量在上升，trend 本身不 increase。

registers.general: Year after year, {series_name} keeps taking a bigger slice.
registers.ielts: The dominant trend is a consistent rise in {series_name}, which now accounts for {share}.
registers.business: The sustained shift toward {series_name} is the story here; everything else is noise.

words.note_zh: 口语，比 account for 随意。

comparisons.meaning_zh: 都表示占比例；account for 更正式，make up 更口语。
comparisons.grammar_zh: account for + 百分比；make up + 百分比（make up for 是“弥补”）
comparisons.collocations_zh: account for 31 percent / make up about a third
comparisons.usage_zh: 写作优先 account for；口语用 make up，但别说 make up for the total。

examples.en: Coal accounts for 49 percent of the mix, and gas makes up another 8 percent.
examples.zh: 煤占结构的 49%，天然气再占 8%。

comparisons.meaning_zh: proportion 是比例，可为分数或小数；percentage 必须能和百分数对应。
comparisons.grammar_zh: the proportion of A in B；the percentage of A
comparisons.collocations_zh: a high proportion of / the percentage of students
comparisons.usage_zh: 说 a high proportion 不用具体数；percentage 后常出现具体百分数。

examples.en: A large proportion of the mix is still coal, at 49 percent.
examples.zh: 结构中很大比例仍是煤，占 49%。

comparisons.meaning_zh: percent 是相对变化；percentage point 是两个百分比相减的绝对差。
comparisons.grammar_zh: rise by 5 percent（相对）；rise by 5 percentage points（绝对）
comparisons.collocations_zh: up 5 percentage points / a 25 percent increase
comparisons.usage_zh: 从 20% 到 25% 是涨 5 个百分点，同时是相对增长 25%。

examples.en: Renewables rose by 19 percentage points, from 24 to 43 percent.
examples.zh: 可再生能源上升 19 个百分点，从 24% 到 43%。

comparisons.meaning_zh: grow 泛指数量或份额增长；expand 强调规模、范围变大。
comparisons.grammar_zh: grow by 8 percent / grow to 40 percent；expand into new markets
comparisons.usage_zh: 份额涨用 grow/rise，别用 expand 接百分比。

examples.en: Wind and solar grew from 10 to 33 percent of the mix.
examples.zh: 风电和光伏在结构中从 10% 增长到 33%。

comparisons.meaning_zh: 都表示由部分组成，comprise 主动，compose 常用被动。
comparisons.grammar_zh: A comprises B and C；A is composed of B and C
comparisons.collocations_zh: comprise four segments / be composed of three parts
comparisons.usage_zh: 避免 is comprised of（争议用法），写作改用 consist of。

examples.en: The bar comprises four segments and is composed of two broad groups.
examples.zh: 这根柱子包含四段，由两大组构成。
